Name: Flirty Seb Gives Presents
Author: Kagurahime
Description:
This mod will tweak Seb's dialogue so that he's nicer to you when you're friends, flirty once you're dating and sweet when you're married.
Once married he will also begin to randomly give you presents.

Some presents he'll offer: coffee, Iridium bar, gold bar, Food, Magma geode, Iridium sprinkler etc.


Optional:

If you're married to Sam and want a mod to make him do something similar, [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/890/?]click here.[/url]

For dirty talking sam that gives iridium bar, gold bar and battery pack [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/862/?]click here.[/url]

To turn Seb's 10th heart scene into erotica, click here.
